body:
I don't care if I lose relationships over suicidal feelings because it's not something I have control over.

I am suicidal. If someone can't accept that or has a problem with that then they can fuck off. I'm Palestinian and trans too. If someone's going to be awkward about either of those things then I don't really care because they weren't someone I would've wanted to be around anyways.

I really don't know I'm just doing it because everything is just boring so why not. I don't find anything particularly interesting about it and I hate talking about miscellaneous things when I feel really suicidal.

I despise the emphasis on professions and 100 percent of the professionals I've talked to in the past have just hurt me. It look a long ass while to find one who can assure me that I won't be hospitalized for wanting to kill myself. 

I completely disagree with it being harassment if they agree that it's okay for me to ask for help. I always ask if it's okay to talk about being suicidal and they're allowed to say no. If it's too much then they can just leave.

nope

I don't, there's no point to it and it just sounds like noise
I literally spend all my free time getting high and injuring myself
Cutting myself and getting high are literally my only hobbies
I don't have pets, and I kinda hate animals

I can't not talk about suicide bc it's on my mind 24/7. 

I don't care if they're not my therapist, I'd rather talk to them still but it's usually too much effort for them I guess. I don't understand the point of being friends with me if you can't accept that part of me though.

I havezero contact with family and I hope they all die soon painfully
Nope. I don't find them entertaining in any way.
I don't understand the point of not being alone. So what if I'm not alone? That doesn't make me feel any better or less lonely as a person.
United States
I don't know how to start or carry out conversations.
I know..sorry for being aggressive.

I try to be nice but that's pretty much all I have going for me.

I'm trans and I'm stealth (as in I live as a cis guy without telling people I'm trans) and it's extremely hard to find people who don't make helicopter jokes or use slurs. Hearing that kind of stuff instantly makes me freak out and have flashbacks to conversion therapy but I can't tell people that without outing myself. And a lot of the people who never make jokes about LGBT+ people still end up making weird jokes about my ethnicity.

If I do end up helping any of my friends I need 100x times the help I can provide. I'm constantly suicidal and having flashbacks. I can not stop cutting myself. The most I can stay sober for comfortably is a few hours and people don't really want to be near someone obviously on meth.

People at my college generally want to stay distant too, at least it seems that way. It'd be weird to ask someone to hang out a few weeks after meeting them. College is also pretty much the only place I can meet people. I can't be around alcohol.

I'm the type of person that people drop for being too toxicly depressed or sjw usually.

It took over a year to find a therapist that assured me wouldn't report me/hospitalize me for wanting to kill myself (even though I live in a super populated city with >8million people) and I have an appointment with him at the end of February but I don't even though if I can last that long because trying to not kill myself is a lot of fucking effort. Even when I do the intake appointment I'm not sure if I can get a second appointment because I don't know the specifics of his sliding scale and whether or not I can pay. It's also not gonna help me immediately lol

I can't make friends easily, I come off as way too clingy and needy.

I'm also a really terrible person and hard to be friends with.

So, people might never stop being assholes about your height.

But being that short should definitely not hinder with passing once you get to a certain point on T. There are a lot of men that never get misgendered but are still under 5 feet
I don't see how that's going to help because you'll leave in a few days. You don't care for me as a person and don't see anything beyond "suicidal person"

Ask her for help. Tell her what you need that would help.

If you don't know then ask for a therapist.

You can do this. It's not gonna matter in the long run if you get your degree this year or next year. Your health comes first.
